welcome.title: Welcome to Scan2Text
welcome.bullet1: Works fully offline; your files never leave this PC.
welcome.bullet2: No accounts, no telemetry, no document content or file names in logs.
welcome.bullet3: Big or dense files can take several minutes; the app stays responsive.
welcome.bullet4: Output is best-effort Markdown — always double-check important numbers.
